ABX Innovative Packaging Solutions, LLC.note: Advanced Barrier Extrusions (ABX) was acquired by Graham Partners in 2018 and later combined with assets from Berry Global to form ABX Innovative Packaging Solutions.

Atedia Films.note: EiM Capital acquired Amcor Flexibles Dax in January 2025, which was subsequently renamed A.T.E.D.I.A. Films.

Dunmore Corporation.note: Steel Partners Holdings L.P. acquired Dunmore Corporation in February 2018 to operate as a standalone business under its API Group subsidiary.

Novotex Italiana S.p.A..note: Novotex Italiana S.p.A. operates as part of Gruppo Coim S.p.A.

Perlen Packaging AG.note: Perlen Packaging operates as the packaging division of the CPH Group and has completed acquisitions rather than being acquired.

Polythene Industries Limited.note: The company is owned by the Ramco Group of Companies and continues to operate under its own name in East Africa.

Safeco Hygiene Films Private Limited.note: Safeco Hygiene Films Private Limited remains an independently operating private company incorporated in 2012.

Sterimed Group.note: Sterimed Group was acquired by IK Partners alongside a management-led consortium in 2025.

UFlex Limited.note: UFlex Limited was founded in 1985 as Flex Industries Ltd and remains an independent public company under founder Ashok Chaturvedi.

Zhejiang Huanlong New Material Science &.note: The company remains an active, independently operating private TPU film manufacturer with investments from various technology and private capital fund partners.

AllFlex S.r.l..note: AllFlex S.r.l. operates as part of the independent All Flex group alongside All Flex S.p.a., with no record of an external acquisition.
